name: Leanpill

card.summary: The community belief that getting lean is the single biggest lever for looking attractive, because lower body fat sharpens the face and body.
card.note: A framework term, not a product; extreme dieting carries its own risks.

quick.overview:
In looksmaxxing slang, the leanpill is the idea that reducing body fat is one of the most effective ways to look better. Proponents say a leaner face shows more bone structure, such as the jawline and cheekbones, and a leaner body looks more athletic.

It is a community term rather than a product or a researched protocol, and the discussion is mostly anecdotal, centred on before-and-after transformations.
quick.how: People who subscribe to the idea cut calories, track weight and add training or cardio to lose fat. Discussions also address side topics such as whether supplements like creatine cause facial water retention.
quick.risks: There is no product to take, so risks come from whichever method is used. Rapid or extreme dieting can have health costs, and facial fat loss is not controllable by area.

lead: Leanpill is looksmaxxing slang, modelled on the community's 'pill' vocabulary, for the belief that becoming lean transforms a person's looks. Proponents point to before-and-after photos in which weight loss changed how the face and body appeared.

People use the idea to prioritise body-fat reduction ahead of other changes: a lower body-fat percentage is said to reveal the jaw, cheekbones and eye area, and to make the physique look more defined.
The term is used in forum discussions on looksmax.org, where users discuss related questions such as whether creatine causes water retention in the face [1]. No published studies use the term.

chain: Reduce overall body fat through diet and activity
Less facial fullness and more visible bone structure
Sharper, more defined face and physique
angle.text: Fat loss changes how the face and body read, and followers treat it as a foundation for every other improvement. The term describes the belief rather than a method.

paras: Within looksmaxxing, 'pills' are named worldviews or frameworks. The leanpill holds that getting lean is a major, accessible route to improved appearance.

Forum users post transformation threads as illustrations of the idea. Others ask practical questions that connect to it, such as a thread asking whether creatine increases water retention in the face, where replies discussed different creatine forms [1].

lore.intro: On looksmax.org the leanpill is referenced in threads about weight-loss transformations and supplements [1].

claims.claim: Getting lean is a major driver of facial attractiveness
claims.believers: Proponents point to individual before-and-after transformations as proof that fat loss reshapes the face.
claims.experts: No published studies have tested the term, though body composition affects facial appearance.

claims.claim: Creatine may add facial water retention that works against leanness
claims.believers: Forum users ask whether creatine bloats the face and some suggest particular forms such as HCl [1].
claims.experts: No study cited here has examined creatine and facial appearance.
